what: The full computer-use command issued through the console on a real Windows 11 desktop (model anthropic/claude-sonnet-5), six attempts on 2026-09-21 between 02:39 and 03:57 local time, the user working on the same desktop and, from the fourth attempt, starting the run from the panel's start button with dry run off. Each attempt is the run's status payload exactly as the page polled it; step rows are in the ledger under session_id = "<run_id>:<goal index>" (which=act), planning-model calls under session_id = run_id (which=cu_llm). The sixth attempt saved hello.txt on the user's Desktop containing "hello world". Everything the attempts exposed was fixed in the same PR with a regression test.

exposed: key chords were not executed: SendInput sent 0 of 6 events — the INPUT union lacked MOUSEINPUT, so sizeof(INPUT) was wrong on x64 (fixed in jevskill/cu/act.py)

ten escalations in a row answered with an action that did not execute — three consecutive unexecuted escalation actions now end the goal

in the Save As dialog every Jev step was unknown_op: the 60-candidate cap dropped the file-name edit and the Save button and the region cascade found no region — the operator passes cap=150 (single decide: type file-name 0.91, click Save 0.94) and observes with a 1500 ms budget
